name: derive-and-validate-adam
title: Derive and validate ADaM
description: Derive ADaM with derive-adam, validate it with validate-with-core (ADaMIG), and loop: when the standards reviewer marks a CORE finding 'fix', the derivation runs again in fix mode and changes only the program lines behind that finding, then CORE validates again (at most three derivation rounds). Start with a study package of SDTM + ADaM spec, or with existing ADaM + programs + lineage to validate them first (start = validate).
preamble: CDISC terms (SDTM, ADaM, ADaMIG, CORE rule IDs, Define-XML, USUBJID) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kinds sdtm + adam-spec, or adam + adam-program + lineage for start = validate.

triggerInput.name: start
triggerInput.description: derive: derive ADaM first. validate: validate the package's existing ADaM first and derive only to fix what the reviewer rejects.

steps.name: Route
steps.description: Deterministic. Decides the next move (derive, validate, or stop after three derivation rounds) and hands on the current study package.

steps.name: Derive ADaM
steps.description: Child run of derive-adam: the AI writes the programs, scripts execute and trace them. In a fix round it changes only the code behind the findings marked 'fix'.

steps.name: Validate with CDISC CORE (ADaM)
steps.description: Child run of validate-with-core against ADaMIG; the standards reviewer records a disposition per finding. Any 'fix' sends the delivery back to derivation.

steps.name: Return the accepted package
steps.description: Deterministic. Returns the validated study package (ADaM, programs, lineage, define, CORE reports and dispositions).
